help_prompt_sub: quickly discover how the application works.
guide_step_nav_text: Tap the logo at the top of the screen to open the main menu and switch tabs.
guide_step_account_text: your account gives you access to your personal features, messaging and other advanced features.
guide_step_feed_text: Use this switcher at the top of the feed to switch between posts and stories.
guide_step_interact_text: discover the publications, react and participate in the community.
onboarding_slide_profile_text: personalize your avatar, your bio and the style of your account from the “more” tab.
onboarding_slide_follow_text: follow accounts to see their posts appear in your feed.
onboarding_slide_posts_text: publishes posts that remain, or stories that disappear after 24 hours.
onboarding_slide_messaging_text: Chat privately with other members from the messages tab.
onboarding_slide_notifications_text: find likes, comments and new subscribers in the notifications tab.
onboarding_slide_advanced_text: ephemeral posts, content generation by AI... identified by a small icon [?] which explains each functionality.
help_article_publications_text: publish a text, an image or a mood on your feed. everyone can react and comment.
help_article_stories_text: stories are visible for 24 hours then disappear automatically. use the selector at the top of the feed to see them.
help_article_messagerie_text: Chat privately with other members from the messages tab at the bottom of the screen.
help_article_notifications_text: find likes, comments, new subscribers and replies in the notifications tab.
help_article_profil_text: Customize your avatar, bio, accent color and font from the “more” tab.
help_article_parametres_text: manages the language, display of AI posts and personalization of your account.
help_article_confidentialite_text: consult the privacy policy to find out what data is used.
help_article_securite_text: activate double authentication (A2F) and manage your password from account management.
help_ai_text: create a content proposal based on your idea, in the creation screen (advanced options). limited to a few generations per week.
help_ephemeral_text: These publications remain available for a period of time that you choose, before automatically disappearing for everyone.
